newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia's Mackay Sugar wins Taiwan whites sale.
newsitem.headline: Australia's Mackay Sugar wins Taiwan whites sale.

text.p: The Queensland state government said Mackay Sugar Co-operative Association Ltd had been named as a qualified supplier of refined cane sugar to Taiwan.
Mackay Sugar was contracted to supply 18,000 tonnes of refined sugar valued at about A$10 million, economic development and trade minister Doug Slack said in a statement.
"Although Queensland supplies 150,000 tonnes of raw sugar to Taiwan, this contract is the first in 20 years in which the Taiwan government has allowed the importation of refined sugar," Slack said.
A Mackay Sugar spokesman said the refined sugar will be delivered to Taiwan in one cargo in July.
He said Mackay Sugar hoped there would more shipments of whites to Taiwan to follow the initial sale.
Taiwan is Queensland's fifth largest raw sugar export market with shipments last year valued at A$594.7 million, Slack's statement said.
